taker_fee_note: OKX perpetual swap, regular user Lv1: maker 0.020%, taker 0.050%. Taker is charged on entry and on every exit (also TP), conservatively.

funding_estimate.note: Where OKX returns no funding history, every funding time is charged against the position at max(floor_rate, p90 of |real rates| of that symbol); marked ESTIMARE in the report.
